text: This app was alright, but the constant ads are a major drawback. It's really frustrating to open an app when I'm in a hurry to get stuff done and have to sit through an ad before I can even see what I need to do. The non-stop barrage of reminders to get the paid "premium" version are also obnoxious as hell, and you literally cannot open the app without being forced to close out *another* ad for the premium version. There are better apps out there and I'm using them now. EDIT: The developers replied and said I should get the premium version if I didn't like the app. They also asked me to rate it 5 stars. To this, I say: many other to-do list apps do not require ads to survive and do not spam the users with requests to upgrade to premium versions. I did not like this app because the ads were intrusive. I don't mind missing access to premium features, I don't even mind a couple ads here and there. But ads every time you open the app? Unskippable videos when you're trying to get work done? This is a serious drawback, and that's why I uninstalled this app and found another one that works better.

developer_reply:
Hola, gracias por tus comentarios. Puede seguir los pasos a continuación para cancelar la suscripción.
1. Vaya a Google Play
2. A la izquierda, haz clic en Mis suscripciones.
3. Seleccione la suscripción que desea cancelar.
4. Haga clic en Administrar. Cancelar suscripción.
5. Dentro de la ventana emergente de confirmación, haga clic en Sí.

text: It's cool and has a widget, but it's not very smart: it shows in the widget all the future tasks. If you click them as complete, they don't disappear, they just get replaced by their same task, but for the next day. If them you go to the app and mark them as incomplete, they accumulate in the upper part of the screen. If then you delete them, they disappear from the calendar... omg, just show the daily tasks and let me mark them as complete! Why do you do this future tasks thing?
author: Daniel Aguilera
developer_reply: Hello, you can click the settings icon in the top right of the widget to show only today's tasks. Your future tasks remain intact because you've set a recurring task. Once completed, the next occurrence appears. To prevent confusion, completed recurring tasks are converted into regular tasks.recurring tasks will be converted into regular tasks.

developer_reply:
"Olá.
Obrigado pelo seu feedback! Você pode seguir as etapas abaixo para adicionar um widget no iniciador
1. Pressione longamente a área em branco do iniciador
2. Clique no widget
3. Encontre a Lista de Tarefas
4. Escolha o estilo de widget que deseja adicionar

Se você tiver alguma dúvida, sinta-se à vontade para nos informar. "
